generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder should have executed similar nature of work such as Implementation of Digital Breath Analysers for Plant Safety.The bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above said works as a Prime contractor for an amount of not less than 2.69Lakhs in any of the preceding FIVE years.Work done value of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.The intending bidder shall submit the work order and relevant work done certificate as documentary proof issued by the competent authority. On demand the original shall be produced for verification

The Bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of 5.4 Lakhs in any two of the preceding FIVE financial years.The bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof.On demand original shall be produced for verification.Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.
